title: The Justice of God
definition: The justice of God means that God always does what is right and judges with perfect fairness.
summary: God never acts corruptly, unfairly, or wickedly. His judgments are true, righteous, and holy.
christFocus: At the cross, God's justice and mercy meet as Christ bears sin's penalty for those who trust Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God never acts corruptly, unfairly, or wickedly. His judgments are true, righteous, and holy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
